metadata.spilltrace:comment: SELF-HOSTED OFFLINE BASEMAP (AD-5, amended 2026-09-12). This file makes ZERO network requests: a background fill for the ocean plus an INLINE GeoJSON graticule (meridians/parallels every 10 degrees, emphasised every 30). Coastlines are deliberately omitted so nobody reads positional accuracy into a basemap that has none. At runtime src/lib/map/basemaps.ts merges the public imagery basemaps (Esri World Imagery / Ocean, CARTO reference maps) into this style as hidden layers; the analyst picks one in the map's basemap control, and 'Offline' returns to exactly this file. Colours here are placeholders: MapView re-applies them from the CSS design tokens (--map-ocean, --map-graticule).
metadata.spilltrace:external-requests: none from this file; imagery basemaps are added at runtime and can be switched off
